{07 16 00}My favorite furniture is
really hard to come by
here in {04 03 00}.

next town over,
they were selling it like it
was nothing! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 08 00}And I spent so much time
at {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s shop, you'd
